title: Observability RCA custom-metric support and optimization guidance need scope clarification
problem: The guide explicitly says only standard default metrics and no custom metrics, while its later optimization guidance says custom metrics can be useful with standard dimensions. This is a scope ambiguity, not evidence of supported custom-metric RCA. Existing explicit restriction is retained; Release Watch owns product-scope reconciliation.

products: Splunk Observability Cloud AI troubleshooting agent
versions: Current rolling documentation; source publication date unknown
exclusions: No custom-metric support, new regional rollout, entitlement or authorization is established.

impact.customerScenario: A reader plans RCA for a detector based on custom metrics.
impact.consequence: Later optimization guidance could be misread as support despite the explicit unsupported statement. Retain the explicit limitation pending clarification.

confidence.rationale: Both statements were independently read in the same public document; their intended relationship remains unknown.

scopeComparison: Both statements discuss RCA metrics in the same current guide; the later paragraph may describe useful context rather than supported detector eligibility. That narrower interpretation is possible but not stated explicitly.

evidence.section: Use AI troubleshooting agent to identify potential root causes
evidence.statement: The guide explicitly limits supported detectors and alerts to standard default metrics and states that custom metrics are not supported at this time.
